[no-leak] is precisely what guarantees the trace carries the whole of authority, so it is the semantic core the flagship formalises and the reason the person can be dispensed with in favour of the work.

Label: enriches
Description: Trust is enrichment over the risk base: the hom-objects in which interactions are valued take their values in the linear/conserved structure that [risk-linear-base] provides, so trust is literally "measured in units of exposure". This is why trust cannot be freely duplicated or manufactured — it inherits the resource-sensitivity of the base it is enriched over, and spending it is spending something conserved.

Label: instantiates
Description: The verification layer is the discharge moment of borrow–work–give-back built as infrastructure: a claim borrows assumptions, work produces a proof object, and the checker discharges the dependency publicly, returning a reusable verified form. So the layer does not add a new kind of logic on top of the framework's; it is [logic-as-contextual-transformation] with its fourth moment — discharge/return — mechanised, which is precisely what lets verification be public and impersonal rather than a matter of someone's word.

Label: instantiates
Description: [workilibrium-logic] is a reflexive realization of [logic-as-contextual-transformation]: the framework read as its own cared-for equilibrium is one concrete case of "valid transformation under context" — the context being the framework's own practice. It instantiates rather than replaces the general notion; the notion of logic stays broader than this single equilibrium reading, which is why the derivational `forced-by` edge remains on [logic-neighbour-colimit] and not here.

Label: instantiates
Description: [workilibrium-logic] is the concrete realization of the abstract [pendulum-equilibrium] in the logic domain: the framework read as its own cared-for working balance. This is the framework entering the pendulum as the (still-seeded) logic instance's equilibrium, and it is the edge that ties the whole pendulum family back into the core — through workilibrium's existing links to [recursive-context-articulation], [anchor-care], [noether-conservation], and [logic-as-contextual-transformation]. It makes the harmony thesis explicit: the project is an instance of the very shape it uses to read others.

Label: presupposes
Description: The "optimality of care" half of [workilibrium-logic]'s dyad is [anchor-care]: the order-two, anti-managerial affect that keeps independent inquirers independent while remaining open to common truth. Workilibrium presupposes it — without care the equilibrium degenerates into managed inheritance, the very reduction (a parent optimising for the bequest) the concept explicitly rejects.

Label: presupposes
Description: "Return to equilibrium" is well-defined only against something conserved across the swing; [workilibrium-logic] presupposes [noether-conservation], the conserved accounting that makes a return a genuine return rather than a reset that forgets its debts. The conservation underwrites the balance that care then tends.

Label: presupposes
Description: The "return to equilibrium" half of [workilibrium-logic]'s dyad *is* the recursion of [recursive-context-articulation]: the milieu accounting for itself and being handed on as the next context. Workilibrium cannot stand without that recursive articulation — it is the equilibrium of exactly that motion, read on the logic pendulum, and the pendulum's own [pendulum-recontextualization] loop is the same move.
